collection.title: Honda Civic Hatchback 2016 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Honda Civic Hatchback 2016 - 2021 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and an 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Civic, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
